title: Relay: bring an audio dispatch feed into Resgrid

scenes.title: Connect the existing dispatch feed
scenes.narration: Resgrid Relay listens to an audio feed, detects configured tones, records dispatch audio, and creates calls for the associated department or groups. It can help departments connect an existing paging process when they cannot modify the upstream dispatch system.

scenes.title: Prepare a controlled audio test
scenes.narration: The recording plan begins with an approved sample audio feed and known tone frequencies. Check the input signal, configure the intended recording behavior, and review the department or group recipients. Verify the exact installer and interface against the supported Relay release before capture.

scenes.title: Verify the resulting call
scenes.narration: Use synthetic test audio. Inspect the resulting call, the captured recording, and the intended recipients. Test nonmatching tones separately and document what was observed. The public Relay installation page contains incomplete older steps, so it is a feature reference rather than a verified modern installation procedure.

scenes.title: Keep the test repeatable
scenes.narration: Retain the synthetic audio fixture, selected release, approved configuration, and observed test result. A recorder will need the supported Relay application and an audio test setup to turn this briefing into a live walkthrough.
